reviews_by_airline.name: reviews_by_airline
reviews_by_airline.purpose: Total number of reviews per airline.
reviews_by_airline.sql:
SELECT airline, COUNT(*) AS total_reviews
            FROM reviews
            GROUP BY airline
            ORDER BY total_reviews DESC

avg_rating_by_airline.name: avg_rating_by_airline
avg_rating_by_airline.purpose: Average passenger rating per airline (NULL ratings ignored).
avg_rating_by_airline.sql:
SELECT airline,
                   ROUND(AVG(rating), 2) AS avg_rating,
                   COUNT(rating) AS rated_reviews
            FROM reviews
            GROUP BY airline
            ORDER BY avg_rating DESC

rating_distribution.name: rating_distribution
rating_distribution.purpose: How many reviews gave each rating from 1 to 10.
rating_distribution.sql:
SELECT CAST(rating AS INT) AS rating, COUNT(*) AS reviews
            FROM reviews
            WHERE rating IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY CAST(rating AS INT)
            ORDER BY rating

monthly_review_trend.name: monthly_review_trend
monthly_review_trend.purpose: Review volume and average rating for each month.
monthly_review_trend.sql:
SELECT date_format(date, 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
                   COUNT(*) AS reviews,
                   ROUND(AVG(rating), 2) AS avg_rating
            FROM reviews
            WHERE date IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY date_format(date, 'yyyy-MM')
            ORDER BY month

complaint_categories.name: complaint_categories
complaint_categories.purpose: Complaint themes among low-rated reviews (rating 4 or below), found by keyword matching. One review can count in several categories. This is a simple keyword method, not a language model.
complaint_categories.sql:
WITH complaints AS (
    SELECT lower(review) AS text
    FROM reviews WHERE rating <= 4
)
SELECT category, mentions FROM (
        SELECT 'Delays' AS category, COUNT(*) AS mentions
          FROM complaints WHERE text RLIKE 'delay|cancel|waited|waiting'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'Baggage' AS category, COUNT(*) AS mentions
          FROM complaints WHERE text RLIKE 'bag|luggage|lost'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'Customer service' AS category, COUNT(*) AS mentions
          FROM complaints WHERE text RLIKE 'customer service|rude|unhelpful|staff'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'Seating' AS category, COUNT(*) AS mentions
          FROM complaints WHERE text RLIKE 'seat|legroom|cramped'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'Cleanliness' AS category, COUNT(*) AS mentions
          FROM complaints WHERE text RLIKE 'dirty|clean|smell'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'Food' AS category, COUNT(*) AS mentions
          FROM complaints WHERE text RLIKE 'food|meal|drink'
)
ORDER BY mentions DESC, category

complaints_by_airline.name: complaints_by_airline
complaints_by_airline.purpose: The same complaint themes, split by airline. Powers the heatmap on the Airline Comparison page. Keyword matching, so it misses synonyms.
complaints_by_airline.sql:
WITH complaints AS (
    SELECT airline, lower(review) AS text
    FROM reviews WHERE rating <= 4
)
SELECT airline, category, mentions FROM (
        SELECT airline, 'Delays' AS category, COUNT(*) AS mentions
          FROM complaints WHERE text RLIKE 'delay|cancel|waited|waiting' GROUP BY airline
        UNION ALL
        SELECT airline, 'Baggage' AS category, COUNT(*) AS mentions
          FROM complaints WHERE text RLIKE 'bag|luggage|lost' GROUP BY airline
        UNION ALL
        SELECT airline, 'Customer service' AS category, COUNT(*) AS mentions
          FROM complaints WHERE text RLIKE 'customer service|rude|unhelpful|staff' GROUP BY airline
        UNION ALL
        SELECT airline, 'Seating' AS category, COUNT(*) AS mentions
          FROM complaints WHERE text RLIKE 'seat|legroom|cramped' GROUP BY airline
        UNION ALL
        SELECT airline, 'Cleanliness' AS category, COUNT(*) AS mentions
          FROM complaints WHERE text RLIKE 'dirty|clean|smell' GROUP BY airline
        UNION ALL
        SELECT airline, 'Food' AS category, COUNT(*) AS mentions
          FROM complaints WHERE text RLIKE 'food|meal|drink' GROUP BY airline
)
ORDER BY airline, mentions DESC, category

low_rating_share_by_airline.name: low_rating_share_by_airline
low_rating_share_by_airline.purpose: Share of reviews rated 4 or below, per airline. Airlines with fewer than 3 rated reviews are left out so tiny samples don't look dramatic.
low_rating_share_by_airline.sql:
SELECT airline,
                   COUNT(rating) AS rated_reviews,
                   SUM(CASE WHEN rating <= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_rated,
                   ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN rating <= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                         / COUNT(rating), 1) AS low_rating_pct
            FROM reviews
            WHERE rating IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY airline
            HAVING COUNT(rating) >= 3
            ORDER BY low_rating_pct DESC

sentiment_counts.name: sentiment_counts
sentiment_counts.purpose: Number and percentage of positive, neutral and negative reviews.
sentiment_counts.sql:
SELECT sentiment,
                   COUNT(*) AS reviews,
                   ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct
            FROM reviews
            WHERE sentiment IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY sentiment
            ORDER BY reviews DESC

sentiment_vs_rating.name: sentiment_vs_rating
sentiment_vs_rating.purpose: Average star rating and average model confidence for each sentiment. Large gaps between sentiment and rating can point to model mistakes or to mixed reviews.
sentiment_vs_rating.sql:
SELECT sentiment,
                   COUNT(*) AS reviews,
                   COUNT(rating) AS rated_reviews,
                   ROUND(AVG(rating), 2) AS avg_rating,
                   ROUND(AVG(sentiment_confidence), 3) AS avg_confidence
            FROM reviews
            WHERE sentiment IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY sentiment
            ORDER BY avg_rating DESC

negative_trend_monthly.name: negative_trend_monthly
negative_trend_monthly.purpose: How many reviews each month were negative, and their share of that month.
negative_trend_monthly.sql:
SELECT date_format(date, 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
                   COUNT(*) AS reviews,
                   SUM(CASE WHEN sentiment = 'negative' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative,
                   ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN sentiment = 'negative' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                         / COUNT(*), 1) AS negative_pct
            FROM reviews
            WHERE date IS NOT NULL AND sentiment IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY date_format(date, 'yyyy-MM')
            ORDER BY month

negative_share_by_airline.name: negative_share_by_airline
negative_share_by_airline.purpose: Share of negative reviews per airline. Airlines with fewer than 3 scored reviews are left out.
negative_share_by_airline.sql:
SELECT airline,
                   COUNT(*) AS scored_reviews,
                   SUM(CASE WHEN sentiment = 'negative' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative,
                   ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN sentiment = 'negative' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                         / COUNT(*), 1) AS negative_pct
            FROM reviews
            WHERE sentiment IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY airline
            HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
            ORDER BY negative_pct DESC

sql.airlines:
SELECT airline,
                   COUNT(*) AS reviews,
                   ROUND(AVG(rating), 2) AS avg_rating,
                   COUNT(rating) AS rated_reviews,
                   SUM(rating) AS rating_sum,
                   SUM(CASE WHEN rating <= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_rated,
                   ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN rating <= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                         / NULLIF(COUNT(rating), 0), 1) AS low_rating_pct,
                   COUNT(sentiment) AS scored_reviews,
                   SUM(CASE WHEN sentiment = 'positive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive,
                   SUM(CASE WHEN sentiment = 'neutral' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neutral,
                   SUM(CASE WHEN sentiment = 'negative' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative,
                   ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN sentiment = 'negative' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                         / NULLIF(COUNT(sentiment), 0), 1) AS negative_pct
            FROM filtered_reviews
            GROUP BY airline
            ORDER BY reviews DESC, airline
sql.rating_distribution:
SELECT CAST(rating AS INT) AS rating, COUNT(*) AS reviews
            FROM filtered_reviews
            WHERE rating IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY CAST(rating AS INT)
            ORDER BY rating
sql.monthly:
SELECT date_format(date, 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
                   COUNT(*) AS reviews,
                   ROUND(AVG(rating), 2) AS avg_rating,
                   SUM(CASE WHEN sentiment = 'negative' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative,
                   ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN sentiment = 'negative' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                         / NULLIF(COUNT(sentiment), 0), 1) AS negative_pct
            FROM filtered_reviews
            WHERE date IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY date_format(date, 'yyyy-MM')
            ORDER BY month
sql.complaints:
WITH complaints AS (
    SELECT lower(review) AS text
    FROM filtered_reviews WHERE rating <= 4
)
SELECT category, mentions FROM (
        SELECT 'Delays' AS category, COUNT(*) AS mentions
          FROM complaints WHERE text RLIKE 'delay|cancel|waited|waiting'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'Baggage' AS category, COUNT(*) AS mentions
          FROM complaints WHERE text RLIKE 'bag|luggage|lost'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'Customer service' AS category, COUNT(*) AS mentions
          FROM complaints WHERE text RLIKE 'customer service|rude|unhelpful|staff'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'Seating' AS category, COUNT(*) AS mentions
          FROM complaints WHERE text RLIKE 'seat|legroom|cramped'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'Cleanliness' AS category, COUNT(*) AS mentions
          FROM complaints WHERE text RLIKE 'dirty|clean|smell'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'Food' AS category, COUNT(*) AS mentions
          FROM complaints WHERE text RLIKE 'food|meal|drink'
)
ORDER BY mentions DESC, category

benchmark.data: Synthetic random reviews generated for timing only. Not real airline data.
benchmark.task: Read the CSV, then count reviews and average the rating per airline per month.
benchmark.spark_sql:
SELECT airline, date_format(date, 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
           COUNT(*) AS reviews, ROUND(AVG(rating), 2) AS avg_rating
    FROM bench_reviews
    GROUP BY airline, date_format(date, 'yyyy-MM')
methodology: Each size is run 3 times per engine; the median is reported (all runs are listed).
Both engines read the same CSV from disk, so reading time is included for both.
One discarded warm-up run happens first so JVM start-up is not counted.
Spark uses 2 local threads; pandas uses 1. Timings depend on this machine and other running programs.
A run only counts as valid if both engines return the same number of groups and the same total.
Results from one laptop do not predict a cluster. Spark is designed for data larger than one machine's memory.
